subject: 리딩파워 유형편 완성
title: Pr01
fullPassage: Dear Sir: Our records show that you have not complied with the legal obligation to file your report for the Survey of Specialized Agriculture. I must remind you that this report is required by law (Title 13, United States Code). We mailed you our first request for cooperation (with form enclosed) early in January. A second copy of the form was sent to you with my letter dated March 14. Please complete one of these forms and mail it to us right away. If you fail to do so, we will not be able to complete the survey tabulations on schedule. Thank you for your cooperation. Sincerely, J. Thomas Breen
